## Details

### elekloader

Mod loader: user supplies the stock OS file, the tool builds the custom .syx locally. Device table in the README (3016dca, 2026-11-08): Digitakt mk1 and Digitone mk1/Keys supported; Digitakt II 1.17 and Digitone II 1.12 experimental; Octatrack 1.40C supported (linkable core boots on an MKII); Model:Cycles and Model:Samples 1.13 supported (builds work on both units); Analog Rytm MKII 1.74 supported; Analog Four MKII 1.56 experimental proof of concept (hook bus, mod storage, unused DDR and recovery checked on a unit). Canonical repo is unclear: the forum post also embeds github.com/elekloader/elekloader (web app at elekloader.github.io/elekloader); forks exist (AvroraPolnareff, naturarum, toonst, simonjohansson); none is listed, as none has changes of its own. Forum: builder issue reported 2026-10-19. Licence GPL-2.0-or-later.

_Latest seen (2026-10-31, secondary directories): altstrument.org and the repo (read 2026-10-31): canonical repo is github.com/elekloader/elekloader (183 commits, 103 stars, GPL-2.0-or-later); web app moved to elekloader.github.io/elekloader; the Mac app was absent from v0.9.0 because signing secrets need renewing. v0.9.0 cores: core-4.1 and core-4.1-os1.54 (Digitakt mk1), core-dn1-4.1.1 and -os1.44 (Digitone mk1), core-ar2-0.8 (Analog Rytm MKII 1.74), core-ot-0.8 (Octatrack 1.40C), core-mc-0.3 (Model:Cycles), core-ms-0.1 (Model:Samples), core-a4 0.1-0.4 (Analog Four MKII 1.56). Kit 0.7.0 catalog: 19 cores, 88 mods. machine-pages 1.2/1.3/1.5 need core 3.0+ on Digitakt mk1 and refuse NEIGHBOR 0.6, SOPHIE 1.1.13 and digichain-based machine mods beside them; fxkit 0.1 gives Digitone effect mods a shared mixer, two LFOs, pattern p-locks and a CPU guard; core-dn1 4.1 adds ev_note_queue; kit 0.6.0 gives 4.0 cores larger RAM areas (256 KB Digitakt, 1.25 MB Digitone). docs/ includes AGENTS.md, DEVICES.md, MACHINES-DN2, SHARC-DN2, CORES, FORMAT, BUILDING, ADAPTING (not all read yet - see hardware/MINING.md). The earlier irpina/elekloader repo is where the author's older releases lived._

_Related: uses tool `digikit` (README: checks or gates run in digikit's emulator (not shipped)) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](../PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: forum thread 30, GitHub release v0.4.0, gearnews, dubspot_

### Chopshop

Browser builder for Rytm MK1/MKII OS 1.73 (CHOP with step locks, sample focus, per-track cuts) and Analog Keys OS 1.56 (chord memory, joystick random). Not OS 1.74, not Analog Four. Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later; distribution: browser-installer. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Related: vendors `elektron-firmware-tool` (README: built on elektron-firmware-tool compiled to WebAssembly); builds on `rytm1-mods` (README: built on gdeo607's rytm1_mods) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](../PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### RytmRandomizer

Performance cockpit for the Analog Rytm MK2 and Analog Four MK2 over SysEx: sees the devices at once, transmits nothing until armed, builds and checks kits from recipes against a reference dump. PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (not an open-source licence). Python 3.11+. Found by GitHub code search 2026-11-03.

_Sources: GitHub code search 2026-11-03, README_

### analog-emu (rytm-emu)

Emulator for Analog Rytm, Analog Four/Keys and the Syntakt that boots your own OS file (Syntakt: main screen, digital tracks and modelled analog tracks sound), for testing mods. MIT. Found by GitHub search 2026-11-02; README start read.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### Analog Four / Keys MK1 OS 1.56 mods

Build pipeline that patches the user's own A4/AK MK1 OS 1.56 file with small ColdFire routines. Mods include a scale lock, 303-style slides, kit persistence for the extra settings, a per-track digital path with drive, a digital wave/chord oscillator in place of noise, a random track generator and a resonance limit. Has its own flashing/recovery and hazards docs. The first public firmware mod for the Analog Four found. MIT.

_Related: uses tool `elektron-firmware-tool` (README: it unpacks and repacks the OS) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](../PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### TurboMIDI (C++)

Header-only C++ implementation of Elektron's TurboMIDI speed negotiation (up to 20x DIN MIDI speed). On 2026-11-04 the repo no longer answered anonymously (git asked for credentials, so private or removed); not chased.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_
